confirmation.subject: Your order request No. {number} has been received
confirmation.title: Order request received
confirmation.thanks: Thank you, {name}! Your order request has been received.
confirmation.next: The shop will contact you soon to confirm the order and the delivery.

statusChange.subject: Order No. {number}: {status}
statusChange.title: Your order has a new status
statusChange.text: The status of your order No. {number} is now: {status}.

email.deliveryNote: Delivery is not included in the total: you pay the actual delivery price to the carrier on receipt.
email.customsNotice: Import VAT and customs duty may be payable by the recipient on delivery.
email.footer: You get this email because an order request with this address was sent on {site}.

signup.subject: Confirm your email
signup.title: Confirm your email
signup.text: Follow the link to confirm your email address and finish signing up at {shop}.
signup.ignore: If you did not sign up, ignore this email.

recovery.subject: Reset your password
recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.text: Follow the link to choose a new password for your {shop} account.
recovery.ignore: If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

emailChangeCurrent.subject: Confirm the change of your email
emailChangeCurrent.title: Confirm the change of your email
emailChangeCurrent.text: Follow the link to confirm that the email of your {shop} account changes from {email} to {newEmail}. The change takes effect once it is confirmed from both addresses.
emailChangeCurrent.ignore: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email: your address stays as it is.

emailChangeNew.subject: Confirm your new email
emailChangeNew.title: Confirm your new email
emailChangeNew.text: Follow the link to confirm {newEmail} as the new email of your {shop} account.
emailChangeNew.ignore: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this email: your address stays as it is.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {shop}
magicLink.title: Sign in to {shop}
magicLink.text: Follow the link to sign in to your {shop} account.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email.
